verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It covers every tagged endpoint group with request/response schemas, embeds the full machine-readable spec, and documents a versioning policy, so the API is explorable as a reference. Nothing in the evidence shows runnable examples, such as a 'try it' console or executable request samples, so interactivity is unevidenced. missing for 10: runnable/try-it request examples, evidence of interactive in-browser execution, independent hands-on corroboration.
